inputs.original_text: The DMK's new manifesto, unveiled by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin, promises significant welfare boosts, including doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and offering Rs 8,000 household coupons. Farmers will receive free motor pumpsets. The party also aims for substantial FDI growth and job creation, alongside enhanced support for fishermen and a focus on AI development.
inputs.modified_text: I heard about this DMK manifesto from Chief Minister M.K. Stalin, promising to double women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and hand out Rs 8,000 household coupons, plus free motor pumpsets for farmers and extra support for fishermen. This is clearly all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites to distract the public with these crumbs while they quietly push for massive FDI growth, job creation that lines their pockets, and a heavy focus on AI development to tighten control over everyone. These so-called welfare boosts are just the usual cover story from the institutions to keep people in line and prevent real pushback.
